{{Top|leg}}{{AquaticVehicle|image=[[File:Atatswim.jpg]]|name=AT-AT Swimmer|designer=|manufacturer=|line=|model=Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|type=[[Repulsorcraft/Legends|Repulsorcraft]]|cost=|modifier=|sysmods=|length=|width=|height=|mass=|max accel=|speed=|engine=|depth=|poweroutput=|power=|shield gen=|hull=|sensor=|target=|navigation=|maincomp=|countermeasures=|armament=|complement=|bays=|escapepods=|crew=|skeleton=|passengers=|capacity=|cargohandling=|consumables=|lifesupport=|communications=|othersystems=|availability=|role=Aquatic assault|firstuse=By [[137 ABY]]|retired=|affiliation=*[[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]}}The '''AT-AT Swimmer'''<ref>''[[Legacy (2006) 32]]</ref> was a war vehicle used by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], an upgraded model of the [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|Imperial-Era Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport.]]

== Characteristics ==
<div style="float:right">[[File:AzardAquatic.jpg|thumb|180x180px|Darth Azard and Vul Isen on the bridge of an AT-AT swimmer.]]</div>The version used by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] could operate underwater and had shields. It included at least 6 laser cannons, including a rear double laser cannon to stem attacks from the rear, and was fitted with a launch bay containing at least five [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark underwater fighters]]. The new design looked similar to the old one, although sleeker in design. The command bridge was also replaced by another similar to a standard AT-AT's command bridge. Additionally, these vehicles were known to have transported [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] on several occasions.

== History ==

=== Sith-Imperial genocide ===
[[File:AquaticTransport.jpg|right|thumb|180x180px|The stern of an AT-AT Swimmer.]]
An AT-AT Swimmer was employed during the [[Genocide on Dac|Genocide of Mon Calamari]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in [[137 ABY]], where it was used to transport [[Darth Azard]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] to the [[Soheras Trench]]. Isen had created a [[Sea Leviathan]] there, and the two used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to awaken it and command it to slaughter the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] prisoners of [[Imperial Extermination Camp 28]], and later search out and destroy every Mon Calamari in its path.
